name: sequence_full
src:

  autonumber
  actor U as User
  participant S as Server
  participant D as Database
  U->>S: login(user)
  activate S
  S->>D: query
  Note right of D: indexed lookup
  D-->>S: row
  loop every minute
    S->>S: refresh token
  end
  alt success
    S-->>U: 200 OK
  else failure
    S--xU: 401
  end
  Note over U,S: session established
  Note left of U: happy
  Note over D: idle
  deactivate S
